videos.title: Snap Specs hands-on
videos.description:
The Verge's senior news reporter, Jay Peters, got hands-on with Snap Specs. The new smart glasses are chunkier than we've seen from other brands, but that's because they house all the hardware necessary to let the Specs function as a standalone computer, meaning they don’t need to be tethered to a phone, compute puck, or external battery. There were some highs and lows during Jay's demonstration. Read his full hands-on in the link in bio
